teaser.en: No *samaki wa kupaka* is complete without a squeeze of lime, the small green fruit of the homestead *mdimu*.
teaser.sw: Hakuna *samaki wa kupaka* kamili bila kukamuliwa ndimu, tunda dogo la kijani la *mdimu* wa nyumbani.
teaser.dg: *Samaki wa kupaka* tauna ladha kamili bila kuminyirwa ndimu, tunda dide ra chijani ra *mdimu* wa mudzini.

summary.en: *Mdimu* is the lime, a small thorny tree with sharp green fruit found at nearly every homestead. Its juice brightens coastal food, from grilled fish to *kachumbari*, and is used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mdimu* ni mti mdogo wenye miiba na matunda ya kijani yenye ukali, unaopatikana karibu kila boma. Maji yake huchangamsha vyakula vya pwani, kuanzia samaki wa kuchoma hadi *kachumbari*, na hutumika katika dawa.
summary.dg: *Mdimu* ni muhi mdide wenye miya, wenye matunda ga chijani ga ngbwadu, unaophahikana karibu chila mudzi. Madzige ganaenjereza ladha kpwa vyakurya vya pwani, kula ng'onda wa kuwadwa hadi *kachumbari*, na nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

about.en:
*Mdimu* is a small, bushy, thorny tree with small, glossy, fragrant leaves and white flowers.

Its fruits, *ndimu*, are small and round, with a thin green skin that turns yellowish when fully ripe. They are full of sharp, acid juice and have a strong citrus scent.
about.sw:
*Mdimu* ni mti mdogo wenye matawi mengi na miiba, wenye majani madogo yanayong'aa na yenye harufu nzuri, na maua meupe.

Matunda yake, *ndimu*, ni madogo na ya mviringo, yenye ganda jembamba la kijani linalogeuka manjano kidogo yakishaiva kabisa. Yamejaa maji makali yenye uchachu na yana harufu kali ya machungwa.
about.dg:
*Mdimu* ni muhi mdide wenye mapanda manji na miya, wenye makodza madide ganaala genye arufu nono, na maruwa ga rangi nyereru.

Matundage, *ndimu*, ni madide na ga mviringo, na gada rembamba ra chijani rinarogaluka kukala ra manjano tunda richiivwa kabisa. Ganaodzala madzi ga ngbwadu kali, na gana arufu kali ya jamii ya ndimu.

where.en: *Mdimu* is a homestead tree, grown close to the kitchen where the fruit is needed every day.
where.sw: *Mdimu* ni mti wa nyumbani, unaopandwa karibu na jiko ambapo matunda yake yanahitajika kila siku.
where.dg: *Mdimu* ni muhi wa mudzini, unaophandwa phephi na dziko, ambapho matundage ganahitajika chila siku.

uses.en:
Lime juice is squeezed over fish and into *kachumbari*, the fresh onion and tomato salad. It is one of the key flavours of *samaki wa kupaka*, the grilled fish painted with a sauce of coconut milk, turmeric, lime and chilli.

The lime is also used in medicine.
uses.sw:
Maji ya ndimu hukamuliwa juu ya samaki na ndani ya *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitunguu na nyanya mbichi. Ni mojawapo ya ladha kuu za *samaki wa kupaka*, samaki wa kuchoma anayepakwa mchuzi wa tui la nazi, manjano, ndimu na pilipili.

Ndimu pia hutumika katika dawa.
uses.dg:
Madzi ga ndimu nkuminywa dzulu ya ng'onda na kpwenye *kachumbari*, saladi ya vitunguu na nyanya mbitsi. Ni kahi ya ladha kulu za *samaki wa kupaka*, ng'onda wa kuwadwa anayepakwa mtsuzi wa huwi, chikatsu, ndimu na pilipili.

*Mdimu* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa dawa.

culture.en: The Digo see the lime's family in the forest too: a wild relative, *Toddaliopsis*, is called *chidimu tsaka*, 'little forest lime'.
culture.sw: Wadigo huiona familia ya ndimu hata msituni: jamaa yake wa porini, *Toddaliopsis*, huitwa *chidimu tsaka*, 'kidimu cha msituni'.
culture.dg: Adigo nkuona jamii ya mdimu hata tsakani: nduguye wa tsaka, *Toddaliopsis*, nkuihwa *chidimu tsaka*, 'mdimu mdide wa tsaka'.

names.en: Digo: *mdimu* for the tree and *ndimu* for the fruit. Swahili: *mdimu*, with the fruit called *ndimu*. English: lime. Scientists call it *Citrus aurantiifolia*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdimu* kwa mti na *ndimu* kwa tunda. Kiswahili: *mdimu*, na tunda huitwa *ndimu*. Kwa Kiingereza: *lime*. Wanasayansi huuita *Citrus aurantiifolia*.
names.dg: Kpwa Chidigo: *mdimu* kpwa muhi na *ndimu* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chiswahili: *mdimu*, na tunda nkuihwa *ndimu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *lime*. Kpwa chisayansi unaihwa *Citrus aurantiifolia*.
